rationale: Matches the DeepViewClone trait contract: the deep_clone of a HashMap must produce a map with the same deep-view. This is the strongest concise postcondition expressible with existing vstd vocabulary and captures functional equality of the spec-level map.
risks: Relies on K::deep_clone and V::deep_clone correctness and on hash/deepview lemmas (e.g. no fresh collisions) to make the proof go through.
Implementation uses runtime HashMap insertion order and hashing; verifier may need additional lemmas about HashMap deep_view/dom to discharge proof obligations.
If K::deep_view is not injective, semantics of deep_view equality may mask duplicate-key behaviors; soundness depends on existing hash/deepview axioms already broadcast in the module.
